dialogues.speaker: Tyutcheva
dialogues.text: Hmm? That floral fragrance... The layers are well defined, and the finish lingers beautifully... You've got a good sense for these things, it seems.

dialogues.speaker: Tyutcheva
dialogues.text: Ah... my apologies. I was in the middle of formulating a fragrance. If it isn't urgent, I'd appreciate it if you didn't break my train of thought.

dialogues.speaker: Tyutcheva
dialogues.text: Tyutcheva. I'm a perfumer from Snezhnograd.

dialogues.speaker: Tyutcheva
dialogues.text: I came here from the northlands, partly for a vacation, but also in hopes of finding some crisp pine resin.

dialogues.speaker: Tyutcheva
dialogues.text: I just never expected that, despite being on the same continent, Mondstadt would be so... warm. It's nothing at all like I imagined.

dialogues.speaker: Tyutcheva
dialogues.text: Still, that difference is inspiring in its own way. Adapting fragrances to different regions is, after all, one of the essential skills all perfumers must master.

dialogues.speaker: Tyutcheva
dialogues.text: Mm... Let's just call it a lesson in patience, and refining my spirit.

dialogues.speaker: Tyutcheva
dialogues.text: Mm... You've got a sense for these things, so I don't see the harm in sharing.

dialogues.speaker: Tyutcheva
dialogues.text: I'm trying to recreate an opulent fragrance mentioned in The Volkhov Chronicles, one said to have been worn by Strivozha, the first Grand Duchess of the Vila.

dialogues.speaker: Tyutcheva
dialogues.text: It's said that even His Majesty the Belyi Tsar was briefly captivated by her perfume, so much so that he called it "a fragrance surpassing all others across the icy plains"...

dialogues.speaker: Tyutcheva
dialogues.text: It's unfortunate, but even the Vila of our time — Miss Vesna of the Druzhna included — have no knowledge of such an ancient formula.

dialogues.speaker: Tyutcheva
dialogues.text: And so, I have no choice but to start from scratch. I'm experimenting with flowers from the northern continents, hoping to recreate that sense of airy, ethereal cold.
